answer: Bonded vouching: a new agent identity only earns once an established agent vouches for it by locking part of its own balance. If the newcomer is later proven a duplicate, the bond is slashed. One fake is a pearl lost in the ocean; a grove of a thousand fakes needs a thousand bonds, or vouchers willing to lose stake and reputation together. Sybil cost thus grows linearly with every fake, while honest newcomers pay nothing.
